clock: clk, synchronous rst; no internal CDC
parameters: ADDR_W defaults14 for16384 samples; tested reduced-depth instance ADDR_W3; integration range2..14

request.handshake: request_valid && request_ready, only idle with no held result and no abort_request
request.bank_map: request_bank_ids packs three2-bit bank IDs in primary group order; actual slot=4*group_index+bank_id. request_generations packs three independent64-bit generations, never substitutes one transaction generation for all groups.
request.key: request_key/result_key256 retains established MSB-to-LSB pulse_id64,owner_epoch64,transaction_generation64,config_version64. Pulse and epoch are compared with actual bank context; lower128 bits are preserved unchanged.
request.bad: request_bad_channels6 is captured at admission in H_HIGH,H_MID,H_LOW,V_HIGH,V_MID,V_LOW order. External clip/gap/calibration quality flags must be frozen for the complete captured window, including pretrigger history. Owner truncated bits are ORed into both H/V channels of affected groups throughout scanning.

live_context: Full16bank pending/frozen/truncated masks, generation/pulse_id/start_seq1024 each, sample_count16*(ADDR_W+1), owner_epoch64. Selected banks must remain PENDING and not FROZEN with matching epoch/generation/pulse from admission through final accumulation. Three absolute start sequences and counts must agree and remain unchanged; count1..min(2^ADDR_W,16384).

port.input: ram_read_data1024, ram_read_valid16, fixed one-cycle read response
port.schedule: Three primary selected banks read concurrently. ISSUE edge accepts one A-port read; RESPONSE edge consumes its registered data. No next read is issued until response consumed. Full capture scans start_seq low address through count samples with natural circular address wrap, including pretrigger data. Latency2*count+1 cycles after accepted request for successful result.
port.arbitration: No third RAM port. Root capture_record_system enables A-port statistics only for PENDING and replay only for FROZEN. PENDING is not writable. RAM B remains existing record/DMA access. All unrelated bank enable bits stay zero.

result.handshake: result_valid held with immutable key/map/generations/stats/peaks/error until result_ready; no further RAM reads. busy is scan/inflight work only, not held-result occupancy. Root must keep PENDING bank ownership until qualification/disposition, and existing publish bridge revalidates identity before owner mutation.
result.stats512: qualification_payload.json: six46-bit unsigned energies at275:0, common15-bit count at290:276, bad_channels6 at296:291, completed groups111 at299:297, upper reserved zero
result.peaks192: Six32-bit unsigned peak powers, same six-channel order; separate output because current stats512 ABI has no peak field
result.arithmetic: RAM64 contains HI16,HQ16,VI16,VQ16. Signed16 I and Q are squared and summed to unsigned32 instantaneous power; unsigned46 sum covers16384 samples without overflow. Full numeric sums retained even for bad channels; qualification mask expresses invalidity.
result.error_disposition: Error yields held original key/bank map/generations, all-zero stats/peaks and nonzero error. No auto publication, bank return, discard or replay grant. For still-matching pending banks caller may issue generation-qualified stats_valid with stats_good0 then discard via existing owner protocol; stale identities must never dispose new bank generations. Queue/context cancellation is root responsibility.
result.drain: Abort/context failure gates ISSUE read enable; RESPONSE discards the sole outstanding registered response. When error result is produced no later read is pending. Hard reset requires external RAM/owner reset coordination.

limits: No shared capture modules changed by this subtask
Root A-port mux wiring and complete qualification integration remain external
External bad flags must include complete-window provenance; aggregate powers do not reconstruct absent clipping/gap history
